notes.title: Most Likely the End of Hunted...
notes.content:
So...
    Many of the files of Hunted have gone bad, working as hard as I can to delete and replace them, but it's turning into a rabbit hole. I'm not done trying or anything, just preparing for the increasingly likely event that the game is done. It stings to know that many years are sitting near the edge of the drain. Yes I made backups, but the corruption is in those too, just in a lesser matured state.
   In the event that I can't recover Hunted: No more game updates, I might run "competitions", The new achievement update wont come out, and the game as it is will age slowly until it is forgotten about.
   I want to thank all of you for playing and sticking with us through the entire history of this game. If this is indeed over, then efforts will shift entirely to Roaming The Stars, and we'll try to make that the best we can.  

  Have fun in the current game, go play Roaming The Stars if you want, I'll announce the next time it goes on sale here and on its page. Once again, thanks for playing,
-DrierWhisper Games

Dev story:

In March of 2021 my first ever game (at the time it was Planetary Survival) had begun. 
In May of 2021 production stopped, was abandoned, and work on Sea At War began. Then that stopped and a few other projects were made, of course none completed, then Hunted happened. And Now, an entire year since Roaming the Stars began, work on it started again... And that's where we are now and this time, it's gonna be done.

notes.title: How to play
notes.content:
the trees and rocks or the little metal bits in the ground are mineable  you press E to mine them then they will show up in your inventory the text that you find on the ground tells how to craft certain things.
if it can be placed you click on the item to craft it. If its just a part like ship kits you press F to craft it
